_doc: Emerald-only story objects of Mossdeep (town, Space Center 1F / 2F) and the Mirage Tower (emerald_ch9_mirage 2026-10-12; generated by work/agents/emerald_ch9_mirage/tools/mk_story_json.py from pokeemerald's maps and the trainer registry): scenes in src/field_scripts/scenes/emerald/MossdeepCity_Magma.inc, src/field_scripts/emerald/0670 / 0676 / 0726 / 0750 and scenes/emerald/Route111_Mirage.inc. Positions are pokeemerald's tiles (a Mossdeep room's origin (1,1) and Emerald's map offsets are added by patches/story.py); uid = 200 + the local object number in Mossdeep City, the local number in a room.
